Name: Soulcaster II
Overview:
Venture beyond the borders of Avericia into a new world of mystery and peril. Solve puzzles, discover secret treasure and destroy hordes of foes with the aid of your summoned Guardians.

Return to Avericia to lay the beatdown on Shadowcaster’s minions once again!

Soulcaster II takes everything you loved about the first, and boosts it to the next level. No tampering with the core gameplay, but an improved graphics engine, new puzzle elements, and a new exclusive upgrade system make for an awesome new adventure.
